note: Reviewed source migrations for campaigns that were already frozen. Each record authorizes exactly ONE transition of ONE file between TWO digests. It is not a licence for the file to keep changing: the next edit needs its own record. This file must be committed to have any effect, and stages that accept a file this way announce it rather than reporting an unqualified match.

supersessions.reason: The repository was narrowed to code alone, so reference/ stopped being tracked. Both campaign freezes required every evidence file to be tracked and equal to HEAD, which no longer had a legal solution, so evidence authentication moved to committed digest manifests and these files changed after the campaigns were already frozen. The artifacts they attest to are unmodified; only the code that produced them moved.
